description: Backend API for quote scenario list, create, detail, update, archive, summary, and comparison inputs.
notes: Required by .aidd/spec.md; no /api/v1/scenarios route, scenario service, summary route, or scenario comparison route was found during onboarding.
spec:
1. Add /api/v1/scenarios list endpoint — use batch inArray() queries for child rows (line items, labor entries, fixed costs) instead of calling getScenarioDetail() per row. With a page size of 25, the list call must produce at most ~6 queries total (3 child batches + 1 catalog assumptions + 1 page + 1 count), NOT ~(N×4)+2 per page.
2. Add /api/v1/scenarios create endpoint.
3. Add /api/v1/scenarios/:id detail endpoint.
4. Add /api/v1/scenarios/:id update endpoint.
5. Add archive or delete behavior for scenarios.
6. Add /api/v1/scenarios/:id/summary endpoint.
7. Add /api/v1/scenario-comparison endpoint.
8. Validate status, target margin, tax rate, contingency, discount, notes, and assumptions.
9. Return structured validation errors.
10. Register every scenario route module in create-api-app.ts.
11. Keep backend route files under 300 lines. Extract TypeBox schemas and validation helpers into co-located schemas.ts files rather than inlining them in route handlers. Maintain Elysia type chain — do NOT extract into controller classes.
title: Quote Scenario API
